title: IDD Roadmap Audit Execute
description: A1.5 roadmap-completion-audit verdict and (under --apply) execution result for a roadmap issue.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version of the A1.5 roadmap-audit verdict.

decisionAuthority.description: Source of the roadmap completion decision represented by this verdict.

mode.description: Whether the helper produced an audit plan or attempted roadmap mutation.

roadmapNumber.description: Roadmap issue evaluated by the completion audit.

ready.description: Whether the mechanical roadmap-completion preconditions passed; free-form success criteria still require caller review.

blockers.description: Traversal or readiness conditions that prevent roadmap completion.

kind.description: Classification of the roadmap completion blocker.

target.description: Issue number associated with the blocker, when applicable.

provenance.description: Roadmap and child issue path through which the blocker was discovered.

detail.description: Evidence or explanation for the blocker.

evidenceBody.description: Completion evidence body prepared for the roadmap audit comment.

closed.description: Whether the roadmap is closed or known complete; in an idempotent apply retry, true can reflect trusted prior completion without mutation by this invocation.

claimReleased.description: Whether apply mode released the roadmap-audit claim.

result.description: Human-readable outcome of the roadmap audit or execution attempt.

viewerLoginUnavailable.description: Present (and true) only when the production viewer-login lookup (gh api user) failed for this run; absent when it succeeded.
